name: Straight Launch
description: Plant both feet and hurl the shaft overhand at a still mark with the whole arm behind it.

name: Steady Pointbalance
description: Rest the shaft across the open palm to find its balance point before choosing where to grip.

name: Leadwedge
description: Holding the shaft crosswise in both hands turns aside a reaching blow from a club or blade.

name: Dartpace
description: After the throw take one short pace backward to win back balance and a little distance.

name: Blunt Leadknob
description: Once the throw is spent jab the heavy butt end forward into the ribs of a close opponent.

name: Level Loft
description: Stand square like a pillar and send the shaft overhand in a straight line to the mark.

name: Fletchdash
description: Turning the hip into the throw puts the body's weight behind the release and lengthens the flight.

name: Measured Thinheft
description: Hold the thumb up along the shaft to judge how far away the mark stands.

name: Leadcount
description: Hold the breath for one beat while the point steadies on the mark and then let go.

name: Raised Dartcap
description: Cross both arms with the shaft between them to catch a swinging club before it lands.

name: Easing Tailweight
description: Let the throwing leg carry forward into a drop step that ends the motion balanced.

name: Narrow Whistle
description: Throw at a chalk mark on a wall again and again until every shaft lands within one hand's breadth.

name: Quick Skewerflight
description: Count three beats through draw and pull and release so the arm learns a steady rhythm.

name: Barbedhit
description: Send the shaft through a hanging rope ring to train a flat and level flight.

name: Watching Fletch
description: Pluck a dropped shaft out of the air with a quick hand before it strikes the ground.

name: Loftamble
description: Walk through the whole throwing motion at half speed until the footwork settles into the body.

name: Forward Dropdive
description: Run three strides with the shaft held back and let it go at the last planted foot.

name: Plumeblow
description: Cross the rear leg behind the front on the final stride to whip the arm through the release.

name: Descending Dart
description: Gather speed over many strides and loft the shaft in a long arc toward a distant mark.

name: Skipping Throwloop
description: Dig the heel in at the end of the run to stop dead before the throwing line.

name: Plumetrot
description: Sprint with the shaft trailing low behind the leg so it neither catches nor slows the stride.

name: Folded Dartpoint
description: Pivot at the end of a run and sweep the shaft across the body to knock aside a chasing blow.

name: Tending Barbed
description: Glance over the shoulder mid-run so the mark never leaves sight during the approach.

name: Upward Skewerflight
description: Angle the release high so the shaft climbs and drops steeply onto a mark behind cover.

name: Flat Whistle
description: Releasing low and hard sends the shaft along a nearly straight line at close range.

name: Dartdrop
description: Roll the shaft off the fingertips at release so it spins and flies true.

name: Downward Dropdive
description: Throw from above head height so the point falls steeply and bites into a lower mark.

name: Judging Dartcap
description: Aim a body length ahead of a walking mark so the shaft arrives where they will stand.

name: Smooth Leadknob
description: Heft several shafts in turn and pick the one whose weight suits the throw.

name: Quick Launch
description: Pull a javelin from the bundle on the back and throw it in one smooth motion.

name: Open Skewerflight
description: Keep a second javelin ready in the off hand and throw it as the first lands.

name: Shifting Fletch
description: Reach to the hip rack for the next shaft while backing away from the line.

name: Launchstrike
description: Throw high over the heads of friends so the shafts fall upon the enemy beyond.

name: Backward Thinheft
description: Retreat behind friends once the bundle is empty and draw a short blade instead.

name: Single Whistle
description: Hook two fingers in the cord loop and wrap it around the shaft before the throw.

name: Loftbump
description: Snap the arm forward so the strap flings the shaft out faster than the bare hand could.

name: Square Dart
description: As the cord unwinds in flight the spin it gives steadies the point on its line.

name: Tight Pointbalance
description: Catch a blade on the taut cord and shaft and turn it away from the wrist.

name: Stiff Dropdive
description: Lean back and throw with the strap to reach a mark far past the usual range.

name: Catching Throwloop
description: Whip the strap around a raised arm and pull hard to unbalance the opponent.

name: Gentle Tailweight
description: Shake out a fouled loop in one motion and set the cord again for the next throw.

name: Hard Launch
description: Hold the cord taut and draw the shaft back slowly to settle the aim before release.

name: Sharp Loft
description: Throw to a spot ahead of a sprinting target so the shaft meets them mid-stride.

name: Sudden Whistle
description: Hurl across the path of a passing rider with a sharp wrist turn at the release.

name: Dartdash
description: When the mark swerves flick the shaft out from a quick half turn to follow it.

name: Sideways Dartpoint
description: Move beside the target at its own pace so the throw needs no lead at all.

name: Fletchreview
description: Follow the dust and footprints of a fleeing mark to guess where they will turn.

name: Solid Lightshaft
description: Brace the shaft across the body to blunt the rush of a charging target.

name: Warm Throwloop
description: Rest the shaft on one finger until it hangs level and grip just behind that spot.

name: Barbeddrop
description: Draw the arm back along the line to the mark and release without letting the elbow drift.

name: Leadhit
description: Keep the wrist locked until the last instant and snap it open so the point leaves true.

name: Plumenote
description: Pace off the distance to the mark in shaft lengths to choose the right strength.

name: Planted Leadknob
description: Settle the weight evenly on both feet after release so a counter-rush finds the thrower steady.

name: Fletchtrot
description: Creep forward in a low crouch with the shaft held flat until the quarry is within a short cast.

name: Gnawing Launch
description: Throw for the gap behind the foreleg where one clean strike reaches the vital organs.

name: Plumecowl
description: Plant the butt in the earth and angle the point up to stop a charging beast.

name: Firm Whistle
description: Close to a few paces from a resting animal and throw one short hard cast.

name: Even Dartpoint
description: Stop and read broken grass and pressed earth to learn which way the quarry went.

name: Swaying Loft
description: Back away at a steady walk from a wounded animal and never turn the back to it.
